text:
Maria Chen: opening a small PR to unify envelope handling guidance: streaming + non-streaming fallbacks, a tiny schema note for nullable arrays, and a migration bullet for older plain-text outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/872

Eli Turner: thanks — can we keep the quickstart to one page? readers want a super short example first, then details.

Maria Chen: yep. plan: top has two runnable snippets (stream + sync) and a one-line shim helper. details below.

Kunal Patel: please include the nullable-array example because it's a recurring support case. tiny snippet: ```json
{ "properties": {"tags": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string"}}}}```

Priya Sharma: add a line about empty-string outputs becoming { text: '' } — we saw that in the field.

Maria Chen: added normalize helper: ```js
function normalize(resp) { try { return JSON.parse(resp); } catch(e) { return { text: String(resp) }; } }
```

Sam Wu: for streaming show how to cancel and return accumulated text on parse error. e.g. ```js
stream.on('data', c => { try { push(parseChunk(c)); } catch(e) { stream.cancel(); push({text: accumulated}); } });
```

Eli Turner: link-checker: update references to /guide/streaming#stream-handlers (anchor changed). Also replace a relative link to old migration doc.

Maria Chen: fixed anchors and updated migration links. added two example fixtures under examples/migration/ (null-array.json, plain-text-fallback.json) and a tiny mocha smoke test.

docs-bot: scheduled: link-checker queued for PR 872.

docs-bot: link-checker: 1 failure — broken anchor `/guide/streaming#handlers` in docs/guide/envelope-quickstart.md

Maria Chen: pushing anchor fix now.

docs-bot: link-checker: all clear on re-run.

Kunal Patel: quick wording: change header from "Fallbacks" to "Graceful fallbacks" per style guide.

Priya Sharma: looked through migration note; suggest clarifying envelope.output vs envelope.result naming mismatch with a simple mapping example: `const out = resp.output || resp.result || resp;`

Sam Wu: SDK snippets look good. small nit: use `envelope` instead of `responseEnvelope` in examples for brevity.

Maria Chen: accepted nits and pushed. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/872 (fixtures + tests).

docs-bot: CI: docs-tests passed. link-checker passed. Merge queue: ready.

Eli Turner: approved.

Kunal Patel: approved.

Priya Sharma: approved.

Maria Chen: merging now. will cut a tiny docs patch release tomorrow morning. closing thread.
